items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: I have the original Owen Bauer Book... and he studied personally under Mr. Owen Bauer.

ctx.x: Her name was Pauline Francis. And I was named after my uncle, who was my father's brother, who was Clifford Francis Leeman. He had a very decisive background, too. He graduated from the New England Conservatory of Music in 1915, and I have the original Owen Bauer Book, a hard cover, which is a collector's item now for drummers, and he studied personally under Mr. Owen Bauer.
And he played one Fall season with the Boston Symphony Orchestra which was either 1915 or going into 1916.
